methods: Industry survey using a strategic sample of 280 digital leaders from 51 countries and territories; the report describes respondents as editors, CEOs, and digital executives.

Traffic data sourced from Chartbeat, including aggregated Google-search referrals to news sites; a report footnote says the referral data aggregate over 2,000 news websites and apps in the Chartbeat network.
Additional report input gathered through background conversations, interviews, and emails with publishers, academics, and industry experts.
